security_boundaries: Authentication, authorization, and identity: styio-audit is a local and CI audit CLI; any future service wrapper must declare route authorization before release.
Privacy and PII: audit findings summarize evidence and must not copy personal data or large target-source payloads into reports.
Password handling: styio-audit does not store production passwords; password examples in tests must remain fake fixture material.
Secret, token, key, and credential material: production credentials must stay out of GitHub and out of generated reports.
Production private material is offline or not committed; .env files, private keys, generated key bundles, and deployable secret files are blocked by policy.
Permission matrix and RBAC route authorization must be documented before any hosted or control-plane surface is added.
Deployment security config, TLS, CORS, CSRF, and cookie boundaries are not part of the current CLI runtime; any hosted wrapper must add them before deployment.
SBOM, CVE, and dependency vulnerability scan evidence belongs in release gates for dependency changes.
DAST, black-box, penetration, and security regression evidence is required before exposing a hosted audit service.
Runtime secret manager, KMS, and key rotation own production secret delivery; the audit framework must not generate or commit runtime secrets.
Rate limit, anti replay, replay protection, nonce, and idempotency boundaries must be specified before network write APIs are introduced.
Log redaction, sensitive log handling, and audit log output must avoid leaking target secrets or private material.
SSRF, egress allowlist, URL allowlist, and outbound request boundaries must be defined before arbitrary remote fetch helpers are added.
Command execution uses subprocess allowlist review; shell injection surfaces and unchecked command strings are forbidden.

resource_classes.description: Owns CLI commands, module loading, schema validation, target repository scans, findings, and report serialization.
resource_classes.copying_policy: Target repository data must be read only for audit evidence; reports should summarize findings without copying large source payloads.
resource_classes.concurrency_policy: Audit runs are process-local and read-only; future parallel scans must keep finding collection deterministic.
resource_classes.nullability_policy: Missing repositories, modules, hooks, fields, and target files must become explicit audit findings or CLI diagnostics.
resource_classes.cleanup_policy: Generated reports, caches, and temporary outputs must stay outside tracked source unless intentionally documented.

state_machine.source: CLI commands, loader contracts, unit tests, and generated report payloads.

transitions.on: schema, scope, policy, or hook checks fail
gate exits with pass or archived failure evidence

required_tests: CLI gate/report tests for new audit policies

resource_classes.description: Owns Apache-2.0 policy evidence for Styio-family repositories, source-distribution notice obligations, authoritative local audit workflow template governance, no-commercial-authorization dependency boundaries, SymPolicy release/stable/nightly branch evidence, Unka-Malloc downstream submission boundaries, and sensitive security boundaries.
resource_classes.copying_policy: License policy text must reference canonical Apache-2.0 identifiers and avoid copying target repository source into policy findings.
resource_classes.concurrency_policy: License policy changes must be updated in the default module and documentation in the same delivery.
resource_classes.nullability_policy: Missing license files, missing metadata, missing source-distribution notices, missing authoritative local audit workflows, missing SymPolicy release/stable/nightly branch evidence, invalid Unka-Malloc downstream submission flow, and missing sensitive security boundary evidence must fail as explicit audit findings.
resource_classes.cleanup_policy: Retired license policy wording must be removed from docs and module descriptors together.

state_machine.source: Default module license_policy, README, spec docs, unit tests, and per-repo gate output.

transitions.on: target project is in the Styio-family policy set
license file, metadata, and source-distribution notice satisfy Apache-2.0 policy
gate or report emits passing evidence
required Apache-2.0 evidence is missing or conflicting

invalid_operations: accepting GPL or proprietary license metadata as the Styio-family policy
allowing source or binary redistribution without Apache-2.0 notice preservation evidence
treating a missing license file as a warning

required_tests: unit tests for passing Apache-2.0 evidence, conflicting license metadata, missing source-distribution notice, authoritative local audit workflow template matching, commercial-risk dependency boundaries, SymPolicy release/stable/nightly branch evidence, Unka-Malloc downstream submission-chain enforcement, secret scanning, sensitive security boundary findings, and penetration-resilience hard controls
audit_risks: dangerous auth or crypto pattern drift
